newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT BANGLADESH IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT BANGLADESH IN TO BAT.

text.p: India won the toss and sent Bangladesh in to bat in their Asia Cup match at Colombo's Singahalese Sports Club ground on Thursday.
Play began an hour late at 11.30 a.m. (0530 GMT) due to heavy overnight rain.
INDIA: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Navjot Sidhu, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Saba Karim, Robin Singh, Ajay Jadeja, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruwila.
BANGLADESH: Akram Khan (captain), Athar Ali Khan, Naimur Rahman, Aminul Islam, Minjahul Abedin, Mafizur Rahman, Khalid Mashud, Habibul Hossain, Shaikh Salahuddin, Zakir Hassan, Enamul Hoque.
